About this item

  • HEALTHIER GUMS: For healthier gums in just 1 week, remove 100% more plaque and even 2.5X in between teeth with Oral-B's most advanced electric toothbrush for adults technology
  • MAXIMIZE YOUR CLEAN: Always maximize your clean with iO light ring timer -that celebrates a dentist recommended 2 minute brush- and toothbrush head change alert
  • ORAL-B APP: Never miss a spot with the Oral-B app that tracks how and where you brush in real-time.
  • GUM PROTECTION: Protect your gums with iO pressure sensor, Oral-B iO signals if you brush too hard, too soft or just right for an effective and safe clean, a feature unique to this rechargeable toothbrush for adults.
  • PERSONALIZED CLEANING SETTINGS: Personalize your brushing choosing among 5 cleaning settings making this adult toothbrush versatile for all your oral care needs.
  • CONVENIENT BRUSHING: Brush conveniently on the go with travel electric toothbrush case.

Product Description

The iO is Oral-B’s best technology: Clinically Proven 100% Cleaner teeth & healthier gums in 1 week versus a regular manual toothbrush. The i05 coaches you to a perfect clean with a Smart Display, this is real time personalized coaching. The accompanying App detects the position through Artificial Intelligence. Oral-B is on your team for your everyday brushing task. A Round head and gentle micro-vibrations, the Magnetic interaction delivers smooth, harmonious motion through a Synchronized cleaning action (micro-vibrations synced with oscillations). A Built-in-2-Minute Timer ensures an even easier experience, helping you get an optimal clean on all your teeth. The Oral-B's quadrant timer breaks the two minutes up into four 30-second intervals to clean each quadrant of your mouth; we keep the time, so you don’t have to. Delivering the perfect pressure is done by having a Pressure Sensor. The Pressure Sensor Indicates optimal cleaning pressure and warns of over pressure. With an accompanying travel case, you’ll have a fresh clean everywhere you go. We’re with you on your next trip or even your mid-day on-the go brushing! Best of all, it is brought to you by Oral-B—the #1 brand used by dentists worldwide.* *Based on surveys of a representative worldwide sample of dentists carried out for P&G regularly. Do not use on children under age 3. Replace brush (head) every 3 months or sooner if brush head becomes worn.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find the electric toothbrush effective and appreciate its cleaning performance, with one noting the visual pressure sensor helps protect gums. Moreover, the toothbrush is easy to use and clean, and stays charged for a week. However, the battery life and value for money receive mixed reviews - while some say it stays charged for a week, others report the battery doesn't last long, and while some find it worth the price, others consider it overpriced. Additionally, the brush size receives mixed feedback, with some finding it too big for small mouths, and durability is a concern as the toothbrush doesn't last more than 4 months.

    This toothbrush replaced my Philips Sonicare, and I can honestly say I’ll never go back. It provides a noticeably better cleaning experience, especially along the gumline. The round brush head and circular motion are much more effective for me than the side-to-side movement of my Sonicare.

    My teeth feel significantly cleaner after each use, and I’ve noticed a fresher, more polished feeling overall. The toothbrush also charges quickly, and the compact charging base takes up very little counter space, which is a nice bonus.

    I absolutely love this toothbrush and highly recommend it to anyone considering making the switch!

It makes my mouth feel super clean, especially behind my front teeth, which is an area I usually struggle to get to with manual brushes. The small head is perfect for reaching my back molar teeth, which is great since I have a smaller mouth.

    The bristles are a bit firm and felt a little rough on my gums at first, but I think I’m starting to get used to them. It might not be ideal if you have very sensitive gums. That said, the toothbrush arrived quickly and was packaged really nicely, which I appreciated.

    Overall, I’d recommend it if you’re looking for an effective and compact electric toothbrush!

About this Item

  • HEALTHIER GUMS: For healthier gums in just 1 week, remove 100% more plaque and even 2.5X in between teeth with Oral-B's most advanced electric toothbrush for adults technology
  • MAXIMIZE YOUR CLEAN: Always maximize your clean with iO light ring timer -that celebrates a dentist recommended 2 minute brush- and toothbrush head change alert
  • ORAL-B APP: Never miss a spot with the Oral-B app that tracks how and where you brush in real-time.
  • GUM PROTECTION: Protect your gums with iO pressure sensor, Oral-B iO signals if you brush too hard, too soft or just right for an effective and safe clean, a feature unique to this rechargeable toothbrush for adults.
  • PERSONALIZED CLEANING SETTINGS: Personalize your brushing choosing among 5 cleaning settings making this adult toothbrush versatile for all your oral care needs.
  • CONVENIENT BRUSHING: Brush conveniently on the go with travel electric toothbrush case.

Product Description

The iO is Oral-B’s best technology: Clinically Proven 100% Cleaner teeth & healthier gums in 1 week versus a regular manual toothbrush. The i05 coaches you to a perfect clean with a Smart Display, this is real time personalized coaching. The accompanying App detects the position through Artificial Intelligence. Oral-B is on your team for your everyday brushing task. A Round head and gentle micro-vibrations, the Magnetic interaction delivers smooth, harmonious motion through a Synchronized cleaning action (micro-vibrations synced with oscillations). A Built-in-2-Minute Timer ensures an even easier experience, helping you get an optimal clean on all your teeth. The Oral-B's quadrant timer breaks the two minutes up into four 30-second intervals to clean each quadrant of your mouth; we keep the time, so you don’t have to. Delivering the perfect pressure is done by having a Pressure Sensor. The Pressure Sensor Indicates optimal cleaning pressure and warns of over pressure. With an accompanying travel case, you’ll have a fresh clean everywhere you go. We’re with you on your next trip or even your mid-day on-the go brushing! Best of all, it is brought to you by Oral-B—the #1 brand used by dentists worldwide.* *Based on surveys of a representative worldwide sample of dentists carried out for P&G regularly. Do not use on children under age 3. Replace brush (head) every 3 months or sooner if brush head becomes worn.
